data.one_liner: Share text, links or files to a specific WhatsApp contact from Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The plugin checks if WhatsApp (or Business) is installed, then lets you share a message, URL or local files to a given phone number. It works on Android and iOS via native intents.
use_when: You need to send content directly to a WhatsApp contact
You want a null‑safe, simple API for WhatsApp sharing
You target Android and iOS only
avoid_when: You need to share to apps other than WhatsApp
You prefer a fully cross‑platform share sheet without native setup
You require advanced UI or fallback handling
strengths: Null‑safe and works on both platforms
weaknesses: Requires manual Android FileProvider and iOS podfile changes
No automatic fallback if WhatsApp is missing
data.setup_notes: Add FileProvider entry and provider_paths.xml in AndroidManifest; modify ios/Podfile to use_frameworks; no extra Dart tooling required

alternatives.name: share_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides generic sharing to any installed app without platform‑specific configuration

alternatives.name: url_launcher
alternatives.why_pick_it: Can open WhatsApp URL schemes for simple text sharing without native plugins
